description:
The Vilano SHADOW 3.0 has been updated with a great new look. This affordable entry-level road bike is well suited for commuting, exercise/fitness, or club rides. With brake lever integrated shifters, a lightweight 6061 aluminum frame with an integrated headset and internal cable routing. The integrated brake lever shifters offer precise and controllable braking and 14-speed shifting in a convenient single unit designed for the road. The Vilano SHADOW 3.0 is an excellent entry-level road bike.

The Shadow 3.0 is the latest version of Vilano’s popular SHADOW road bike line.

The bike is shipped factory direct. Assembly & Tuning are Required. Pedal installation can be tricky, please follow included directions closely.
